Sorimachi"............"
Sorimachi"Mr. Kakizawa?"
Sorimachi"Yes, yes, Sorimachi speaking..."
Sorimachi"Yeees. From here also, we had a very good view. That splash—quite satisfactory, was it not... Heh, heh. You have taken much trouble."
Sorimachi"So far as our obligation to the sponsor is concerned, we may call the account settled..."
Sorimachi"...Finished? No, no. On that point, please do not misunderstand."
Sorimachi"That part has yet to begin... Heh, heheheheh."
Sorimachi"Now comes our main business. For this part, kindly take proper care."
Sorimachi"—And see, before I have finished saying it. Kheh, kheh. Khekhekheh. The bastard—"
Sorimachi"Here he comes."
